title: DAMPyF: a Python implementation of the DAMPF method for the simulation of open-system dynamics
summary: DAMPyF is an open-source Python implementation of the dissipation-assisted matrix product factorization (DAMPF) method, a tensor-network-based approach for the numerically exact simulation of finite-dimensional quantum systems coupled to bosonic environments. The method relies on a pseudomode representation of structured reservoirs and a matrix-product-state representation of the density matrix of the extended system, comprising the system and the pseudomodes.
